name: Enable Large System Cache
description: Enables Large System Cache to prioritize file-system caching over application memory, which is mainly useful for specific workloads.

description_i18n.en: Enables Large System Cache to prioritize file-system caching over application memory, which is mainly useful for specific workloads.
description_i18n.de: Aktiviert die große Systemspeicher-Cache-Funktion in Windows, um das Dateisystemcaching gegenüber dem Anwendungsspeicher zu bevorzugen. Dies ist vor allem für bestimmte Arbeitslasten nützlich.
description_i18n.fr: Active le cache système large pour privilégier la mise en mémoire tampon du système de fichiers par rapport à la mémoire des applications, ce qui est principalement utile pour certaines charges de travail.

warnings.title: Reboot recommended
warnings.message: A system restart is required for the new cache behavior to take full effect

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the registry value LargeSystemCache at HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management to set it to 1 This changes how Windows allocates memory between file caching and application processes
